currentPriorities.title: Promotion Ledger Multi-Source
currentPriorities.why: The promotion history ledger only reads the single hardcoded hermes-promotion-v1.json artifact, so it would silently miss any future Hermes promotion workflow version.
currentPriorities.desiredOutcome: Generalize the ledger writer to discover and append events from every Hermes promotion artifact, not just hermes-promotion-v1.json.

currentPriorities.title: Operating Loop CI Coverage
currentPriorities.why: CI only runs npm run check and npm run mastra:check, neither of which exercises the Sentra/Hermes promotion and ledger loop, so a regression there would go unnoticed.
currentPriorities.desiredOutcome: Wire the Sentra/Hermes operating loop (context, promotion, ledger) into a script CI already runs.

currentPriorities.title: Hermes Agentic Workflow Run Closeout
currentPriorities.why: Multi-project prioritization selected Hermes Agentic Workflow as the top project, but its run-v4 PR lifecycle has been tracking-ready with no branch, push, or PR across multiple cycles, and no closeout artifact has been produced.
currentPriorities.desiredOutcome: Produce the proposed post-merge ledger (or an explicit closeout decision) for run-v4 so the top-priority project stops stalling.
